assigned.task: Reduce wing area or increase aspect ratio to decrease fuel burn and GTOW as recommended by the MDO integrator. Use TiGL to modify the aircraft geometry parameters and generate the updated volumetric mesh.
Compute aerodynamic coefficients (CL, CD, L/D) using SU2 on the updated mesh exported by the geometry engineer.
Estimate the operational empty mass (OEM) and component breakdown using mass-mcp based on the updated CPACS geometry.
Size the turbofan engine and produce SFC and thrust tables using pycycle-mcp based on the updated aircraft geometry.
Configure the mission parameters using Aviary based on the updated geometry, wing mass, and engine scale factor.
Run the Aviary coupled aircraft-trajectory SLSQP optimization and report all results precisely.
Synthesize outputs from all other roles into a multi-objective assessment and issue the final verdict.

Reduce wing area or increase aspect ratio to decrease fuel burn and GTOW as recommended by the MDO integrator. Use the provided CPACS file and modify the wing parameters accordingly. Export the updated geometry and generate the volumetric mesh for the next steps.

Run the SU2 solver on the updated volumetric mesh generated by the geometry engineer. Compute aerodynamic coefficients (CL, CD, L/D) and ensure solver convergence. Report the results including convergence status and any observations.

Estimate the operational empty mass (OEM) and component breakdown from the updated CPACS geometry. Validate the inputs and report the OEM, wing mass, component breakdown, and structural feasibility assessment.

Size the turbofan engine based on the updated aircraft geometry and sizing parameters. Produce SFC and thrust tables, ensuring cycle convergence. Report the results including convergence status and any observations.
Define the mission parameters and integrate aircraft-level parameters using Aviary. Set the mission values and validate the configuration based on the updated design parameters.

Run the Aviary coupled aircraft-trajectory SLSQP optimization using the updated mission parameters. Report all simulation results including convergence status, fuel burned, gross mass, and trajectory data.

Synthesize outputs from all disciplines and issue the final verdict on the design's performance and constraints. Check if all constraints are satisfied and determine the next steps based on the optimality gap and disciplinary conflicts.
